title: CardIoT: firmware, hardware design files, FHIR examples, and load-test script
description: Firmware, hardware design files, FHIR request examples, and the load-test script of CardIoT, a gateway-less 12-lead ECG prototype based on the STM32F769I-DISCO board and the TI ADS1198 analog front-end. Associated article: 'CardIoT: A Gateway-less Edge 12-Lead ECG Prototype with Native FHIR Interoperability for Point-of-Care Testing' (Medical & Biological Engineering & Computing, under review). Licenses: CERN-OHL-S-2.0 for the hardware design files, MIT for the firmware and the load-test script, and CC BY 4.0 for the documentation and FHIR examples. Research prototype; not a medical device.
